name: frontmcp
stderr:
Build, test, and deploy MCP servers with FrontMCP

Usage
  frontmcp [options] [command]

Getting Started
  create [name]                         Scaffold a new FrontMCP project (interactive if name omitted)
  init                                  Create or fix a tsconfig.json suitable for FrontMCP
  doctor                                Check Node/npm versions and tsconfig requirements

Development
  dev                                   Start in development mode (tsx --watch + async type-check)
  build                                 Build for a deployment target
  test [patterns]                       Run E2E tests with auto-injected Jest configuration
  inspector                             Launch MCP Inspector (npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector)
  inbox [link]                          List and answer the questions a server keeps for you, with the inbox link its console printed

Process Manager
  start <name>                          Start a named MCP server with supervisor
  stop <name>                           Stop a managed server (graceful by default)
  restart <name>                        Restart a managed server
  status [name]                         Show process status (detail if name given, table if omitted)
  list                                  List all managed processes
  logs <name>                           Tail log output for a managed server
  socket <entry>                        Start Unix socket daemon for local MCP server
  service <action> [name]               Install/uninstall systemd/launchd service

Package Manager
  install <source>                      Install an MCP app from npm, local path, or git
  uninstall <name>                      Remove an installed MCP app
  configure <name>                      Re-run setup questionnaire for an installed app

Skills
  skills search <query>                 Search the skills catalog using semantic text matching
  skills list                           List all available skills in the catalog
  skills install [name]                 Install skill(s) to a provider directory (.claude/skills or .codex/skills)
  skills export                         Convert a catalog skill into a Cursor / Windsurf / Copilot rule file, or export the project's own @Skill entries to agent skills folders (--from-entry)
  skills publish <name>                 Publish a skill to a public marketplace (Smithery or Glama)
  skills read <nameOrPath> [reference]  Read a skill, its references, or any file in the skill directory
  skills help [command]                 display help for command

MCP Registry
  registry keygen                       Create the Ed25519 key that proves your domain to the MCP Registry
  registry publish                      Build server.json, validate it, and publish it to the MCP Registry
  registry status <status>              Mark the server active, deprecated, or deleted
  registry help [command]               display help for command

Other
  mcpb                                  Manage MCPB (MCP Bundle) archives
  eject-mcp-config <client>             Emit a ready-to-paste MCP client snippet. Supported: claude-code, claude-desktop, cursor, windsurf, vscode
  plugin                                Install the current FrontMCP server as a plugin for an AI tool
  help [command]                        display help for command

Options
  -V, --version                         output the version number
  --list-commands                       List every registered verb (built-in + project) and exit
  -c, --config <path>                   Path to frontmcp.config file (overrides upward search and FRONTMCP_CONFIG env)
  -h, --help                            display help for command

Examples
  npx frontmcp create my-mcp              # Scaffold a new project
  frontmcp dev                             # Start dev server with hot-reload
  frontmcp build --target node             # Build for Node.js deployment
  frontmcp start my-app --port 3005        # Start managed server
  frontmcp install @company/my-mcp         # Install from npm registry
  frontmcp skills se
